# Kuber Bassi (KUβER βΔSSI) — Official Portfolio & Music Summary

Canonical website: https://kuberbassi.com/

## Identity & Aliases

- **Full Name:** Kuber Bassi
- **Music Artist Moniker / Stylization:** KUβER βΔSSI (featuring Greek letters beta `β` and delta `Δ`)
- **Alternative / ASCII Spellings:** KUBER BASSI, kuβer-βΔssi, kuberbassi, Kuber
- **Roles:** Independent Software Engineer, Product Engineer, Music Producer, Composer, Guitarist
- **Location:** New Delhi, India

## Overview

Kuber Bassi is an independent engineer and music producer based in New Delhi, India.

In software, he builds useful digital products, browser applications, automation systems, AI-assisted tools, and creative experiences. His engineering work focuses on simplicity, performance, maintainability, clean interfaces, and long-term thinking.

In music, he produces and releases original music under the artist moniker **KUβER βΔSSI**. His musical work spans cinematic ambient, electronic, post-rock, progressive ambient, phonk, and layered guitar soundscapes.

## Portfolio Philosophy

Useful things. Carefully made.

Kuber builds software, products, and creative tools with simplicity, performance, and long-term thinking.

Core working principles include simplicity, precision, performance, structure, intent, consistency, and curiosity.

## Technical Toolkit

Technologies and tools shown in the portfolio include:

- Languages: C, C++, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, HTML, and CSS.
- Product and interface development: React, Node.js, Express, Flask, Tailwind CSS, Vite, and GSAP.
- Data and backend systems: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Supabase, and Firebase.
- AI and automation: OpenAI tools, Gemini, AI tooling, workflow automation, and browser automation.
- Infrastructure and workflow: Git, GitHub, Docker, Vercel, Cloudflare, Linux, Figma, Canva, and Notion.

This list represents tools used in his workflow and should not be interpreted as a proficiency ranking or certification list.
